paragraphs.text: Jay Annelli is a Vorthos writer and podcaster. He acts as a consultant and editor for Wizards of the Coast and describes himself as "Loremaster". He offers informed clarifications and interpretations of the lore, but is not a Wizards staff member and does not control the canon.

Annelli is one of the hosts of The Vorthos Cast . He wrote lore columns for GatheringMagic . Since 2018, those columns are available on CoolStuffInc.com . Under the handle Jay13x , and prior to his work as a consultant, he was previously an admin on MTG Wiki .
